item.title: Jamal Bryant slammed for buying wife flesh-colored gala dress: 'Lowering of standards'
item.description: Christian leaders and influencers are speaking out about the dress that megachurch Pastor Jamal Bryant bought for his wife to wear to a gala event last month, sparking debate about how Christians should present themselves in public. #PastorJamalBryant #pastorswife #churchministry #Christianliving

item.title: Ex-porn star-turned-pastor weighs in on Lily Phillips' baptism: 'Let's pray for her'
item.description: A former porn star-turned-pastor is weighing in on an OnlyFans star’s announcement that she was recently rebaptized and the criticism that has followed. #LilyPhillips #JoshuaBroome #OnlyFans #Instagram

item.title: Secular church-state watchdog can't intervene in Johnson Amendment case, judge rules
item.description: A federal judge has denied a request by a progressive church-state watchdog group to intervene in a case that centers on the constitutionality of an Internal Revenue Service rule that prohibits houses of worship from endorsing political candidates. #AmericansUnitedforSeparationofChurchandState #JohnsonAmendment #NRB #IRS #taxexemptstatus #Texas

item.title: After months of confusion, Northern Seminary and first black president agree to part ways
item.description: Northern Seminary in Lisle, Illinois, has parted ways with the school’s first black president, Joy J. Moore, following months of confusion about whether she resigned just before she was to be installed in the position last October. #NorthernSeminary #JoyMoore #Resign

item.title: Brown shooter didn't recall shouting 'Allah Akbar' but has no regrets for murders: transcripts
item.description: The man who committed a mass shooting at Brown University that resulted in two deaths has denied that he said “Allah Akbar” during the tragic incident. #Brown #shooter #Valente #MIT #professor #EllaCook #massshooting #CharlieKirk

item.title: Trump admin. revises 'food pyramid' to prioritize protein, veggies; Americans urged to 'eat real food'
item.description: The Trump administration has what it calls a clear, common-sense message to the American people: eat real food. #WhiteHouse #SecRobertFKennedy #HHS

item.title: Christian ministry can't be forced to hire employees who don't share its beliefs: appeals court
item.description: A federal court has sided with a Christian ministry seeking to ensure it has the right to hire only employees who agree to abide by its religious beliefs, ordering the state of Washington not to enforce a nondiscrimination law against the organization. #FirstAmendment #Washington #AllianceDefendingFreedom #Religiousliberty

item.title: Lauren Daigle says Gen Z is the 'future' of revival: 'It's amazing to watch'
item.description: Lauren Daigle believes the seeds of revival are already taking root — and she says the clearest signs are emerging among young people. #LaurenDaigle #revival #mentalhealth

item.title: Amy Grant releases wistful single about Jan. 6, Woodstock: 'We've lost our way'
item.description: Contemporary Christian singer Amy Grant released a new single this week that wistfully reflected on whether the riot at the U.S. Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021, marked the end of the 1960s idealism supposedly embodied at Woodstock. #AmyGrant #January6 #music #entertainment

item.title: 4 things to know about the ICE shooting of Renee Good in Minneapolis
item.description: Wednesday morning's shooting in Minnesota, in which a woman was shot dead while in her car by a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent, has sparked an explosive debate among Americans and politicians about whether the use of deadly force was justified. #Good #shooting #Minneapolis #ICE #Minnesota #immigration #Noem #Trump
